meaning_vi: làm tỉnh táo, làm khoẻ khoắn
dễ chịu, thích thú (bởi cái khác thường, mới lạ)

sentences.en: The Warder's handbook for 1952 is refreshingly frank.

sentences.en: The company's dedication to providing luxury watches for all income levels keeps the market both competitive and refreshingly diverse.

sentences.en: The PRS Foundation for New Music The PRS Foundation for New Music (PRSF) is a refreshingly approachable and adventurous funding body.

sentences.en: His talk was insightful and refreshingly astringent and very much enjoyed.

sentences.en: But of the Russians he met, McKay found Trotsky's views the most perceptive - refreshingly practical and free of racial stereotyping.
